name: Emoji Movies
description: Describe your favorite movie in nothing but emojis — then the class cycles through every clue and types their guesses. The reveal is the fun part.

intro.message:
EMOJI MOVIES

Think of a movie you love. You'll type its name — kept secret — and then describe it using ONLY emojis.

Like this: 🦈🌊🏖️😱

Then we cycle through everyone's clues and guess each other's movies.

fields.label: The movie title (kept secret until the reveal)
Describe it in emojis only — no letters, no numbers

get-ready.message:
All clues are in! One movie at a time — type your guess when the emojis appear.

If it's yours: keep a straight face.

guess.prompt:
{{_current.fields.clues}}

Type the movie you think this is:

reveal-movie.message:
The guesses:
{{guess.responses.list}}

It was… {{_current.fields.movie}}!

(described by {{_current.playerName}})

Hands up if you got it!

wrap.message: That's Emoji Movies! Same class next time — new movies, harder clues.
